 NEW YORK KNICKS SIGN DALTON KNECHT TO TWO-WAY CONTRACT
 NEW YORK, October 23, 2026 –  The New York Knicks announced today that the team has signed  Dalton Knecht  to a two-way contract.
 Knecht , 25-years-old (6-6, 215-pounds), most recently appeared in 54 games with the Los Angeles Lakers last season. Knecht tied the NBA rookie single-game three-point record after he registered a career-high 37 points on 75.0-percent shooting, nine three-pointers on 75.0-percent shooting, five rebounds and one steal against Utah (Nov 19, 2024). The third-year veteran holds career averages of 7.1 points and 2.2 rebounds over 15.5 minutes in 132 games with the Lakers.
 The Fargo, ND-native was originally selected by the Los Angeles Lakers with the 17th overall pick in the 2024 NBA Draft out of Tennessee. As a fifth-year senior, Knecht was named a 2023-24 Consensus First-Team All-American, SEC Player of the year, SEC Newcomer of the Year, First-Team All-SEC and earned the 2024 Julius Erving Award after averaging 21.7 points, 4.9 rebounds and 1.8 assists over 30.6 minutes in 36 games for the Volunteers. He spent his junior and senior seasons at Northern Colorado where he averaged 14.3 points on 46.4-percent shooting, 5.3 rebounds and 1.3 assists over 29.4 minutes in 67 games.
